item.title: October Lantern 0.6.22
item.description:
Stop

  • While Lantern is answering, or an agent from your Ask chat is working, the send button turns into Stop. It stops the agent where it is and keeps it open for your next message. (Grok can't be stopped this way, so it gets no Stop.)

Faster at using your apps

  • Agents open websites and apps in one step instead of clicking through the browser, and look at the screen only when they need to.
  • Claude Code starts with Lantern's tools ready, saving a step the first time it uses them.
  • Updated Cua Driver (0.44): typing is faster.

Show me

  • Show me can now point at entries in sidebars and lists, such as Appearance in System Settings, instead of guessing a spot on the screen.

Setting up October on Windows

  • If your computer can't reach npm, where October is downloaded from, Lantern now says so within a minute instead of waiting 5 minutes and failing. Trying again picks up where the download stopped, and a slow connection gets up to 15 minutes.

Also

  • Grok Build agents show when they're working and when it's your turn, with their last message and chat.
  • New recipes for fixing a bug and cleaning up a CSV.
  • Buttons are labelled for screen readers on every platform.

The Windows installer isn't code-signed yet: if Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click More info, then Run anyway.
